Based on the image provided:

1)  **Near the camera at bottom-right.** The rifle is held in the first-person view, so the muzzle flash appears in the foreground on the right side of the screen, not toward the center.
2)  **From the tip of the long barrel.** In a standard FPS view, the muzzle flash originates from the front end (the muzzle) of the weapon, which is pointing away from the player.
3)  **Yes, it curves toward the camera.** The rifle shown is an AK-style weapon with a curved magazine. Since the magazine hangs down from the gun, the curve bows outward, which is **toward the camera/player's perspective** (and downward), rather than curving forward toward the muzzle.
